facts.statement: Modem Control at address 4 is write-only, Line Status at address 5 is read-only, Modem Status at address 6 is read-only.
facts.quote:
Modem Control 4 8 W Controls modem
Line Status 5 8 R Status information
Modem Status 6 8 R Modem Status

facts.statement: Clearing LCR bit 7 to 0 disables Divisor Latch access and returns to normal registers.
facts.quote: Set bit 7 of LCR to ‘0’ to disable access to Divisor Latches.
